name: onefoundry-company-memory
description: Search authoritative reviewed company facts. Existing keys stay read-only; a separately granted capture key can preview and submit explicitly selected company excerpts for operator review.

interface.longDescription: Read current approved company facts with source citations. Optional bounded conversation capture creates pending candidates. The server enforces project and company grants; operator review, deletion, raw database access, and hidden chats are unavailable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find approved company context relevant to this project and cite the current source-linked facts.
